erxes-operation-description: Any erxes GraphQL query or mutation
web-search-description: Search Wikipedia for articles related to a query.
fetch-url-description: Fetch full text content of a Wikipedia article by title.
calculator-description: Evaluate a mathematical expression and return the numeric result.
operations-discovered-at-runtime: Operations are discovered from the gateway at runtime.
search-operations-placeholder: Search by what it does or its name… (e.g. "create deal")
response-fields-hint: Space-separated GraphQL fields to return. Used only when the operation returns an object type.
identity-description: The LLM uses the name and description to decide when to call this tool.
tool-id-hint: Unique machine identifier. Auto-generated from name.
description-placeholder: What this tool does — the LLM uses this to decide when to call it
disabled-tools-hint: Disabled tools won't be available to any agent
agent-settings-intro-title: Set up how this agent works
agent-settings-intro-description: Work from top to bottom: define its role, choose its model, then decide what it can do and who can use it. Changes take effect after you save.
agent-settings-identity-description: Give people and the AI enough context to understand this agent's purpose.
agent-settings-name-description: The name people see when choosing or chatting with this agent.
agent-settings-description-description: A one-line summary that helps people choose the right agent.
agent-settings-agent-id-create-descripti: Used in the bot endpoint and generated from the name. You can change it before creating the agent.
agent-settings-agent-id-edit-description: Used by the bot endpoint and existing conversation threads, so it cannot be changed here.
agent-settings-instructions-placeholder: You are a customer support agent. Answer clearly, use approved tools when needed, and ask before making destructive changes…
agent-settings-instructions-description: Tell the agent its role, boundaries, tone, and how to handle uncertainty. These instructions are sent with every conversation.
agent-settings-model-description: The provider runs the model; the model determines this agent's capabilities and response style.
agent-settings-no-providers-description: Add a <providerLink>provider</providerLink> before creating an agent.
agent-settings-provider-description: The service account used to run this agent.
agent-settings-model-live-description: Available models are loaded directly from the selected provider.
agent-settings-access-description: Choose which erxes data and actions this agent may access.
agent-settings-tool-policy-description: Operations include both reading data and making changes in erxes.
agent-settings-selected-tools-descriptio: Limit the agent to the operations you explicitly choose below.
agent-settings-all-tools-description: Allow the agent to discover and run any read or write operation from installed services.
agent-settings-full-access-title: This agent has full erxes access
agent-settings-full-access-description: It can discover and run any available query or mutation, including operations added by newly installed services.
agent-settings-destructive-description: Decide whether a person must approve destructive operations before they run.
agent-settings-ask-first-description: Pause before every delete or merge and wait for a person to approve it.
agent-settings-run-immediately-descripti: Allow deletes and merges to run without a confirmation step.
agent-settings-no-approval-title: Destructive operations will not ask first
agent-settings-no-approval-description: Deletes and merges can run as soon as the agent chooses them. Use this only in tightly controlled workflows.
agent-settings-visibility-description: Control who can find this agent and start conversations with it.
agent-settings-visibility-help: The creator always keeps access, even when a specific audience is selected.
agent-settings-private-description: Only the agent's creator can see and chat with it.
agent-settings-many-description: Share with one or more people, teams, or departments.
agent-settings-everyone-description: Anyone in the organization with chat access can use it.
agent-settings-audience-description: Anyone matching at least one selected person, team, or department can use this agent. The creator and Agent Admins always keep access.
agent-settings-audience-people-descripti: Selected people can use this agent.
agent-settings-audience-teams-descriptio: Members of selected teams can use this agent.
agent-settings-audience-departments-desc: Anyone assigned to a selected department can use this agent.
agent-settings-no-teams: No teams are available in this department.
agent-settings-behavior-description: Control when this agent responds and what it remembers.
agent-settings-availability-on-descripti: On: the agent can respond to bot webhook requests.
agent-settings-availability-off-descript: Off: the agent stays configured but will not respond to bot webhook requests.
agent-settings-memory-on-description: On: each conversation keeps its earlier messages as context.
agent-settings-memory-off-description: Off: each new message is handled without earlier messages from the thread.
agent-settings-advanced-description: Only change these when troubleshooting or tuning a specific model.
agent-settings-debug-description: Show web searches, fetched pages, and erxes operations instead of only a short turn summary.
agent-settings-max-steps-description: The most consecutive tool calls allowed in one turn (1–50). Increase this only if the agent regularly stops before finishing.
agent-settings-temperature-description: Lower values are more consistent; higher values are more varied. Some models require a fixed value.
